study_identification_part.si_4_title: Heterogeneous brain dynamic functional connectivity patterns in first-episode drug-naive patients with major depressive disorder

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Data from International Big-Data Center for Depression Research (IBCDR) was used. Subjects were from multiple centers in China (164 healthy individuals and 91 FEDN-MDD from one center; 125 healthy controls from two other centers).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "In this study, we employed data from International Big-Data Center for Depression Research (IBCDR), which was collected in China ... 164 healthy individuals and 91 FEDN-MDD patients (60 females) from the same center were included. ... Another independent sample (125 control individuals, 71 females) from the other two centers"
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Jing2023.pdf.md: Materials and Methods / 2.1 Standard protocol approvals, L83-L91

answer.IBCDR (FEDN-MDD, N=91): patient cohort for deviation quantification and subtype clustering

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The healthy-base group (N=91) was matched to patients and used to build second-order polynomial regression normative models via 10-fold cross-validation. The healthy-ICA group (N=125, from other centers) was used to compute group-level independent components as guidance for GIG-ICA. FEDN-MDD patients (N=91) were evaluated for deviations from normative models and clustered into subtypes.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "To prevent bias from these unmatched data, we used the matchIt function in R ... to select the comparable group from the healthy controls as the healthy-base group for the patients ... Another independent sample (125 control individuals, 71 females) from the other two centers with similar data acquisition was a healthy-ICA group to create the group-level components as guidance information in ICA." ... "To assess generalization, we applied 10-fold cross-validation to build an aggregation normative model for each feature"
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Jing2023.pdf.md: Materials and Methods / 2.1 and 2.3, L89-L113

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The healthy-base group (N=91) had 65 males reported in Table 1. Female count was calculated as 91 - 65 = 26 (28.6% female, 71.4% male). Train-phase breakdown was not separately reported.
